subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retire the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow, or must it keep or replace the post-publish release repair path before this PR lands?
rationale: The PR changes release recovery policy, and source inspection shows the remaining npm release workflow is not an equivalent path after npm has already accepted the package.

options.title: Replace repair path before deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow, then update specs/deploy.md and release-workflow tests to that path.

options.title: Keep the existing workflow
options.body: Leave the standalone workflow and runbook in place until release owners decide the recovery path is no longer needed.

options.title: Retire with owner acceptance
options.body: Release/security automation owners may accept the operational tradeoff if they document how to recover a failed GitHub Release after npm publish.

recommendation.title: Replace repair path before deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow, then update specs/deploy.md and release-workflow tests to that path.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick has the clearest file-history connection to both the existing release automation and this proposed retirement, with openclaw/openclaw-secops as the CODEOWNERS route.
